hypothesis: Lift the existing native distance-aware lower-bound rejection from individual outgoing ports to contiguous blocks, preserving original occurrence and heap insertion order.

activation.entry: P9 USE_REGIONAL_BLOCK_PRUNING=true; other pipelines retain false/default. Recognized native cost/key/get/set/reset/expansion method identities only.
activation.domain: Existing OWNED_REGIONAL_HOP_FRONTIER=true, distance-aware search, at least32 regional ports, finite nonnegative distance scale;16-occurrence contiguous blocks. Ineligible domains call the original expansion directly and discard any stale index for that frontier.
activation.nativeContract: tiny-hypergraph/lib/core.ts:269-282 explicitly requires owned ordinary topology/problem/state, immutable key mappings and metadata between steps, standard IndexedCandidateHeap behavior and pure scoring; prohibits external queued-reference mutation/injection and observable key/closure hooks.
activation.metadata: Fast form uses that existing immutable metadata contract. X/Y/penalty/incidence/neighbor-array replacements invalidate; direct helper optional validateContents=true additionally detects in-place edits and is tested separately. The ordinary fast path does not promise arbitrary in-place external metadata or best-array writes outside the declared owned contract.
activation.physical: Ports, identities, endpoint metadata, capacity/net/ownership/layer checks, scoring/weights, search/rip/effort/iteration/worker budgets and native errors remain represented and unchanged. No route candidate or fallback path is introduced.

certificate.geometry: For finite source/rectangle coordinates, componentwise distance from source to the block bbox is no larger than the absolute native source-minus-leaf subtraction. Monotonic native squares/add/sqrt and multiplication by nonnegative scale preserve the inequality, including overflow/subnormal cases.
certificate.orderedArithmetic: Compute ((candidate.g + live regionCongestion) + minimumPenalty) + bboxDistance*liveScale in the same order as the native pre-computeG lower bound. Compare against an upper bound on the largest current destination best cost. No regrouping, epsilon, approximate cost or chord normalization.
certificate.goals: Any block containing the goal always descends to native leaf semantics; this retains goal-before-section/self/incidence checks and the return after even a rejected distance-aware goal acceptance.
certificate.unknownCosts: Initial maximum is not usable until a real refresh. NaN or unknown best cost then sets maximum to NaN, disabling certification even if the geometric lower bound overflows toInfinity.
certificate.ordering: Left-to-right occurrence traversal is unchanged for all surviving leaves. Native lower-bound/score/heuristic/setter/heap expressions and ordering are preserved. Pruned blocks may retain closed occurrences for later native deletion; this changes only private frontier shape and is disclosed in operation accounting.

maintenance.decreases: Reverse hop-to-Set<Block> membership marks a block dirty only when its cached maximum holder decreases. Otherwise a stale-high maximum is safe and simply weakens pruning. Dirty blocks refresh at most once at their next relevant query, not on every bound miss.
maintenance.increasesAndReset: All API best-cost increases/NaN writes invalidate; resetCandidateBestCosts invalidates even uint32 wrap. Queue/closure epoch, route/net/goal, generation, state/best-array/stamp-array, topology/problem and relevant geometry-array changes invalidate. Native source writes best entries through these APIs.
maintenance.knownLeafPrevious: The copied native leaf already holds previousBestCost. Its native-owned pure computeG/H cannot change best costs between that read and write, so the common native setter+dirty notifier reuses this exact value. Other native/API setter calls read fresh first.
maintenance.duplicates: Block hop memberships are set-valued even when native ordered occurrences repeat; cleanup unregisters each membership once. Native occurrences and queue tie order are not deduplicated.
maintenance.lifetime: Reverse maps clear on context/reset; replacement of an individual region neighbor array unregisters its prior frontier. One latest frontier per incoming region; no permanent global problem registry or dependency/prototype patch.
maintenance.factory: Original instance completion factory preserved; recognized congestion-aware synchronous children install before solve. Zero-cost/custom scorers retain their original methods.

evidence.counts: professional-port-fast-coverage.json; full actual SRJ18 sample6 native versus optimized port stage, no local performance timer.
evidence.nativeObserver: Pruning disabled plus explicit COLLECT_REGIONAL_BLOCK_WORK=true installs a native-only observer in the same eligible method/factory domain; it counts actual linked visits until the first native eligible goal, then calls the original expansion unchanged. Ordinary uninstrumented performance runs keep per-query work counters off.
evidence.guardedNegative: professional-port-guarded-coverage.json preserved with original source commit: full content scans and unconditional max refresh introduced more work than justified. Fast form removes this overhead using the pre-existing owned contract and dirty notifications.
evidence.meaning: Native observed eligible occurrences minus optimized leaf visits is the actual native loop-visit reduction. Helper prunedOccurrences includes retained closed links and must not be called actual native visits removed. Block queries/builds/metadata reads/max reads/reverse visits/setter reads/cleanup/mapping/dirty writes are extra and reported independently. Integer counts are not equal-cost CPU units.
evidence.memory: Typed payload bytes count only raw validation arrays. Fast form still owns JS Blocks, hop arrays, Maps, Sets and memberships; maximum live block/key/membership cardinalities are distinct gauges and not bytes or additive totals.

summary.qualification: One actual heavy port problem, operation counts with explicit observer; not CPU-weighted dataset coverage or performance evidence.

validation.focused: Exact native-arithmetic bound oracle; controlled native/optimized queue/best/stamp/goal ordering through duplicates, best increases/decreases/NaN, generation wrap, closed tails, native-domain switches, array replacement and optional in-place validation.
validation.actualDomain: Full sample6 output SHA, port metadata/probabilities, stable statistics, iterations and cap exactly equal. Only native stageStats[*].timeSpent excluded because it is actual wall time.
validation.physicalAndIntegration: Original SRJ18 sample2 bounded regional DRC, async logical budgets and lazy stats tests; TypeScript and workers+ESM+DTS build.
validation.independent: Peer ran12,800 controlled native-vs-fast expansions with51,200 exact assertions; source review is outside this worktree.
validation.noBench: No local timing benchmark, snapshot update, deadline reduction, dependency write or remote mutation.
